Subject: Novara Biotech — Sales→CS readiness manifest and owner assignments

Team / Asha / Thomas,

Thanks again for the commitment — excited to get Novara rolling. Per the signed term sheet (attached) we're set for a 30-day pilot starting the week of Aug 2 with a single-production-like route for document-scoring and a separate sandbox for model tuning. This thread is the internal readiness manifest + owner assignment so CS and implementation have what they need to start planning.

Quick summary:
- Account: Novara Biotech (NB) — deal ID NB-2026-0921
- Pilot start target: week of 2026-08-02 (kickoff meeting to be scheduled)
- Scope: document ingestion → embeddings → semantic search + short-form synthesis for research summaries (low-latency read path)
- Expected QPS: peak ~12 rps, avg 3 rps; median request length ~350 tokens, bursts to 1k tokens for batch runs
- Initial model: rdx-6b-cand (quantized variant) hosted in us-west region (can move to dedicated if needed)
- Compliance notes: Novara requires SOC 2 evidence, optional HIPAA addendum has been requested; Novara will host PII-sensitive test set in a scoping bucket that must be ephemeral
- Commercial: signed term sheet attached; SOW (NB-SOW-v3.pdf) attached for implementation scope and acceptance criteria

Ownership (proposed):
- CS owner (post-sale): Mina Haddad — primary success contact and pilot success metrics
- Implementation lead: Monica Patel — responsible for ingestion, schema mapping, and runbook for acceptance testing
- Solutions/infra liaison: Karthik Iyer — network/KMS/VPC connectivity, performance tuning, and staging validation
- Sales exec: Jordan Blake — deal context and executive escalations

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation to unblock planning:
1) Confirm you accept the owner roles and confirm any staffing overlap concerns
2) Review pilot acceptance criteria in SOW section 3 and call out any missing tests (esp. latency and token accounting)
3) List any required Redwood product features or infra (dedicated capacity, KMS integration, VPC peering) we should factor into the timeline

Asha / Thomas — feel free to add other internal stakeholders from Novara we should loop in for kickoff (security, infra).

I will schedule a 45-minute internal planning touch with Mina/Monica/Karthik for Monday 2026-07-20 10am PT to turn this into a Mutual Action Plan unless folks prefer a different cadence.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0219

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara Biotech — Sales→CS readiness manifest and owner assignments

Jordan — thanks for the summary. Quick technical clarifications from my side before Monday's planning: 

- Staging vs prod footprint: do we expect the sandbox to mirror the prod instance (same model + similar size) or will Novara be fine with a smaller-cost staging model? This affects the KV cache sizing and batch scheduling.
- Data ingress: who will own the pipeline for the initial 10k doc upload? Novara will push via S3; do we want to request that they pre-hash doc IDs and provide a manifest?
- KMS / key management: will Novara bring their own keys (HSM/KMS) or will Redwood manage envelope encryption for the pilot?
- Network: is VPC peering required for the pilot or can we use a temporary secure transfer mechanism (signed URLs)? If VPC is required, we need account IDs asap.
- Acceptance testing: can Monica and I get the pilot dataset (anonymized) and a short list of 8 critical queries to validate relevance + latency?

I can draft the staging runbook if you want — estimate 3 days to validate perf and 2 days for connectivity once we have access.

Karthik
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Verma <asha@novara.bio>, Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@novara.bio>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara Biotech — Sales→CS readiness manifest and owner assignments

Thanks Karthik — good list.

I accept the draft runbook plan. Asha / Thomas: answers inline so CS can plan.
- Staging vs prod: Novara is fine with a smaller staging model for early validation (they explicitly asked to limit cost for initial tuning). We'll run rdx-1.2b in sandbox and rdx-6b-cand in prod path. Monica please size accordingly.
- Data ingress: Novara will upload to an S3 bucket and provide a manifest. I'll ask them for pre-hashed IDs today.
- KMS: Novara prefers customer-managed keys for production but agreed they're okay with Redwood-managed envelope for the pilot. Karthik — we'll need the KMS integration to be togglable between modes for acceptance testing.
- Network: VPC peering is not required for the pilot; we'll use signed URLs and a locked transfer bucket. If peering is required later, we'll collect account IDs during the onboarding call.
- Acceptance tests: Monica, can you confirm you have capacity to run the 8 critical queries and validate latency thresholds (<200ms median for read path)? Karthik, please capture perf runbook notes and add to our shared drive doc.

Next steps / timeline (proposed):
- 2026-07-20 10:00am PT — internal planning (Mina/Monica/Karthik/Jordan) — I will send calendar invite
- 2026-07-22 09:00am PT — kickoff with Novara (Asha/Thomas + security/infra) to gather accounts, manifests, and schedule the initial upload window
- 2026-07-25 — staging validation window (3 days)
- 2026-08-02 — pilot go-live target (production route enabled)

I have uploaded the SOW and term sheet to the deal record (HubSpot link below) and attached a pilot-data-specs.xlsx with fields we expect in the manifest. Also adding the DocuSign executed agreement link for audit.

Received — thanks Jordan. Mina here, I accept the CS ownership and will shepherd the pilot metrics and acceptance conversation. Quick notes from the CS perspective: 

- I'll own the pilot success metrics doc and share a versioned checklist by end of day Monday (2026-07-20) — will include SLAs, behavioral KPIs, and escalation paths.
- Monica: please confirm ingestion bandwidth estimate and whether you'll need any pre-provisioned storage on our side. If staging model is rdx-1.2b, please share expected CPU/GPU requirements for the 3-day validation window.
